items.title: Is AbbVie (ABBV) Undervalued As It Expands Skyrizi In Crohns Disease?
items.summary: What AbbVie’s Skyrizi EMA filing means for ABBV stock AbbVie (ABBV) has moved to expand Skyrizi’s role in Crohn's disease treatment by submitting an application to the European Medicines Agency for a subcutaneous induction regimen in adults with moderately to severely active disease. The filing, backed by Phase 3 AFFIRM data, comes as AbbVie stock reflects a mixed recent pattern, with the share price down over the past week but higher over the past month, past 3 months and past year. items.title: Slate Medicines Starts Migraine Treatment Study
items.summary: By Karen Roman Slate Medicines Inc. said it dosed the first participant in Phase 1 of its clinical study evaluating SLTE-1009, the company’s subcutaneous antibody candidate for migraine treatment. Phase 1 single-and multiple-ascending dose is being conducted in Australia with topline safety data estimated by mid-2027, it stated.
